Subject: RFP stipend eligibility and rollback policy for BioNexa benchmark

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked promising. As we finalize the RFP for the November head-to-head benchmark, procurement asked a couple of clarifying questions about the trial stipend:

- Can Redwood confirm the maximum credit allotment that qualifies as an "RFP stipend" vs. a custom commercial discount?
- What language do you require around rollback/recoupment if the environment is used beyond the agreed benchmark scope (e.g., production traffic during the trial)?

We need this clarified before we circulate the RFP to the evaluation committee. I attached the RFP draft for context.

Thanks,
Ellen Perez
Head of Product, BioNexa
Ellen Perez | BioNexa

Date: 2026-10-02T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP stipend eligibility and rollback policy for BioNexa benchmark

Hi Ellen — great to hear from you and glad the demo was helpful. Quick answers while I pull the full details in:

- Typical RFP stipend ceiling we approve via sales ops is $40k in credits for an evaluation (covers model runtime, embeddings, and basic support). Anything above that usually requires an approvals slate and a revenue commitment.
- We do require a rollback/recoupment clause when credits could be used for production traffic — language is usually limited: Redwood reserves the right to convert excess usage into billable consumption at standard rates and to request reimbursement for material overages. We can provide a one-paragraph clause for inclusion in the RFP.

I'm looping in Ben, Marissa (solutions) and Logan (CS) to confirm recommended scope for your use case and an ops-safe allotment. Attached is a usage_report_template we use to monitor benchmark-only activity.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: recommended stipend and gating for BioNexa RFP

Team — quick internal note before we put numbers to Ellen:

Recommendation: 40k credits stipend for the bake-off (standard three-week benchmark window) conditioned on:

- Dedicated trial environment (isolated API key + IP allowlist)
- Usage reporting every 72 hours using the attached template
- Hard cap monitoring with automatic throttling at 110% of the stipend; any consumption beyond the throttle becomes billable at list and is subject to recoupment

Priyom — finance sign-off needed on $40k credit exposure. Marissa / Logan please confirm we can create a dedicated test pool and the telemetry hooks.

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Internal: recommended stipend and gating for BioNexa RFP — legal redline

Ben / Vanessa / Priyom —

Legal is comfortable with the proposed stipend framework, provided we include a short rollback clause and two additional guardrails:

1) A definition of "benchmark scope" tied to agreed API keys and IP ranges; if usage is observed on any non-authorized key or outside the window, Redwood may suspend access and invoice for billable usage.
2) A maximum recoupment cap equal to the stipend amount (i.e., we will not seek more than the $40k credit value in cash recovery unless there is evidence of willful misuse).

I attached a redline with the one-paragraph rollback language. If Finance confirms the exposure (Priyom), Legal can sign off and we can send a conditional approval to BioNexa.

-Kim

Date: 2026-10-05T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: RFP stipend (conditional) — BioNexa benchmark

Hi Ellen / Ryan — thank you for the patience while we reviewed internally. Redwood can approve a $40,000 credit stipend for the BioNexa November RFP benchmark, subject to the following conditions:

1) Stipend covers one dedicated benchmark window (up to 21 calendar days).
2) Trial will use a dedicated environment: single API key, IP allowlist, and a time-bound role for engineers.
3) BioNexa will run all benchmark traffic under the provided API key and submit usage reports every 72 hours using the attached template. Redwood will provide a telemetry dashboard link for read-only monitoring.
4) Rollback clause: Redwood may convert any confirmed out-of-scope usage to billable consumption at our standard rates; recoupment is capped at the stipend value ($40k) unless willful misuse is proven. Legal redline attached.

Next steps:
- Ellen — please confirm you accept the conditions and we will (a) generate the trial API key, (b) share the read-only dashboard link, and (c) send the stipend confirmation and one-paragraph clause for embedding in your RFP.
- Priyom — finance confirmed exposure and approved the stipend (internal note).

We look forward to a fair benchmark — happy to help with test harness tips from Marissa.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
